notes: Monteverde supplies horizontal calligraphy, 100 sheets without spiral; it does not unambiguously specify squared ruling for its other subjects, so no squared/no-spiral row is inferred.
Only directly verified air-drying modeling paste variants are seeded; do not conflate with firing clay or cold porcelain. Existing Arcilla gains the optional weight field but no guessed weight.
32-note variant uses exact La Salle evidence. Pumahue minimum32-key wording remains a separate flexible requirement.

The catalog supplies an exact 16 GB option independently confirmed by a manufacturer. School minimum 16 GB semantics remain in requirement text/notes; no exact-only interpretation of that school instruction is introduced.
Shared tipo_pauta display-label change from Pauta musical to Tipo de pauta requires guarded migration handling.

semantic_limits: Minimum capacity/count requirements must retain minimum wording; exact catalog values are not acceptance operators.
Absent boolean attributes remain unspecified; no generic false defaults are backfilled.
Package counts apply inside one named bag, box, ream or pack; list quantity counts such requirements.
Source values were deliberately projected to meaningful generic requirements without inferring omitted details.
Historic2025 hygiene evidence establishes generic formats, not a2026 universal school instruction.
